input: Arrange a surprise retirement party for colleagues

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing who the retiree is and their personality shapes the theme, tone, and personal touches of the entire event.
The size of the guest list determines the scale of catering, venue space, budget, and coordination effort.
The venue and timing (office, external location, lunch vs. evening) affect logistics, availability, and the surprise element.
The available budget directly limits choices for catering, decorations, entertainment, and gifts.
Knowing how far away the retirement date is determines urgency and how much planning runway is available.
The desired tone (formal, casual, heartfelt, fun) shapes decisions on décor, speeches, activities, and the overall atmosphere.
Understanding what the organiser most wants to achieve (the surprise, a memorable gift, a speech) helps prioritise where to focus effort.

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a surprise retirement party for a colleague
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a surprise retirement party for a colleague at work, covering all logistics, people, and details needed to make it a success.

questions.title: Who is the retiree and what are they like?
questions.description: Understanding the retiree's personality, interests, and career history helps shape the theme, personalised touches, and tone of the event.

questions.title: How many guests are you expecting to invite?
questions.description: The guest count determines the scale of the venue, catering quantities, and the overall coordination effort required.

questions.title: Where and when should the party take place?
questions.description: Deciding on the venue (office, restaurant, external space) and time of day (lunch, after work, weekend) is critical for logistics and maintaining the surprise.

questions.title: What is the total budget available for this party?
questions.description: The budget sets hard limits on catering, decorations, entertainment, and any gift or keepsake for the retiree.

questions.title: When exactly is the retirement date?
questions.description: The timeline determines how urgently bookings, invitations, and coordination need to happen, and how much planning time is available.

questions.title: What vibe or atmosphere are you going for?
questions.description: The desired tone — formal and heartfelt vs. casual and fun, for example — shapes décor choices, whether there are speeches, activities, and the overall feel of the event.

questions.title: What would make this party feel like a true success?
questions.description: Identifying the single most important outcome — nailing the surprise, delivering a meaningful gift, or ensuring an emotional send-off — helps prioritise the planning effort.
